entries.what: Theo's three-nap schedule finally sticks: crib naps at 9, 12:30 and 4 with 90-minute wake windows, all logged on the shared tracker app.
entries.outcome: All three naps happened in the crib with no contact napping.

entries.what: Brenda's Monday check-in email arrives around 8:15; he skims it and answers later during the 9 a.m. nap.
entries.outcome: Replied briefly and put off the training question.

entries.what: Evening witching hour of crying from 5 to 8 while Hana makes dinner from frozen meals.
entries.outcome: Calmed Theo by humming the ballpark organ tune.

entries.what: Repeats the nap schedule: naps at 9, 12:30 and 4 all held. Takes the 2 a.m. feed the night before and does a morning stroller walk on the marsh boardwalk.
entries.outcome: Two of three naps went exactly to plan.

entries.what: Starts the reassessment-software training module during the midday nap.
entries.outcome: Got through one module before Theo woke.

entries.what: Baby laundry Tuesday night at the card-only Marisol Gardens laundry room.
entries.outcome: Two loads done and folded.

entries.what: Morning nap schedule holds again. He logs wake windows in the tracker app and the weekly summary tab.
entries.outcome: Wake windows stayed near 90 minutes.

entries.what: Hana mentions the city council candidate forum on warehouse growth and Measure K; they skip it because of Theo's evening fussiness.
entries.outcome: Watched a bit of coverage later instead.

entries.what: Begins looking at used crossovers online because the hatchback barely fits the stroller.
entries.outcome: Bookmarked four listings from Ruel Road dealers.

entries.what: Asks the assistant for a weighted comparison matrix of four used crossovers, including rear-door opening angle for the car seat.
entries.outcome: Settled on the top two for a test drive.

entries.what: Takes Theo to Thursday 10:30 baby story time at the library with Kaitlyn's group.
entries.outcome: Theo stayed calm for the songs.

entries.what: Afternoon naps at 12:30 and 4 hold in the crib.
entries.outcome: Schedule is now four days running.

entries.what: Morning stroller walk on the marsh boardwalk, then a call with a Ruel Road dealer to schedule a test drive.
entries.outcome: Booked a Saturday visit.

entries.what: Friday night baby laundry and a takeout pho order from Phở Bến Thành since nobody cooked.
entries.outcome: Ate rare beef pho, no tripe, after Theo's bedtime.

entries.what: Saturday morning trip to Ruiz Family Market with Theo in the carrier, then buys the used 2019 small crossover for $17,400 from a Ruel Road dealer.
entries.outcome: Traded in the hatchback and drove the crossover home.

entries.what: Fits the stroller in the new trunk on the first try and gives it a baseball score out loud.
entries.outcome: Stroller fit with room to spare.

entries.what: Evening witching hour; Theo calms to the humming while Elliot and Hana split the night feeds.
entries.outcome: Theo asleep by 8:30.

entries.what: Lazy Sunday: crib naps hold at 9, 12:30 and 4 even with the schedule off the weekday routine, and the puzzle gets a few pieces added.
entries.outcome: Added a few lighthouse pieces during a nap.

entries.what: Takes the new crossover for a short drive with Hana and Theo to Delgado Park.
entries.outcome: Theo slept in the car seat the whole way.

entries.what: Plans the week and checks the tracker app summary before bed.
entries.outcome: Wrote a short list of Monday tasks.
